      Getting connected is easy

      1. Choose a plan that works for you

      Pick between our 24-month plan which comes with a router, or our 12-month plan which offers freedom and flexibility.

      2. Get activated by NetLink Trust (NLT)

      Your Fibre Termination Port needs to be activated by NLT for your service to work. The NLT appointment takes place within 5 working days after you sign up.

      3. Complete your broadband set-up

      After activation, you’re ready to set up your Optical Network Terminal (ONT) and router. You can self-collect from a GOMO Store, or arrange for installation or delivery. This process can take up to a week after your NLT activation.

      Signing up

      GOMO Broadband is our 10Gbps fibre broadband service for homes in Singapore, offering simple plans at $29.99, billed every 30 days.

      GOMO Broadband is broadband-only, and does not come with a home phone line, TV services, or static IP.

      For details, see GOMO broadband typical download speeds.

      Make sure your GOMO Mobile plan is active

      Devices

      If you choose the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan, a free WiFi 7 router is included.

      If you choose the Core Saver Plan, you can use your own compatible router, or purchase one separately. GOMO customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.

      Add-ons

      The Home Internet Filter (HIF) is an optional add-on that helps you manage and block selected websites on your home network.

      It’s free for the first 6 months, then $3.05 per month thereafter. You can manage HIF anytime on the GOMO app.

Frequently asked questions
Signing up
What is GOMO Broadband?
GOMO Broadband is our 10Gbps fibre broadband service for homes in Singapore, offering simple plans at $29.99, billed every 30 days.
GOMO Broadband is broadband-only, and does not come with a home phone line, TV services, or static IP.
For details, see
GOMO broadband typical download speeds
.
How do I sign up for a GOMO Broadband plan?
1) Choose the plan that suits you most.
2) Enter your installation address for an address feasibility check
3) Select any add-ons where needed (extra routers, Home Internet Filter etc.)
4) Complete your identity verification via Singpass
5) Complete your payment and save your card details for recurring payments
For details, see
Sign up for GOMO Broadband plan
What’s next after signing up for GOMO Broadband
How do I check if my home supports GOMO Broadband?
Enter your installation address during sign-up to run a quick check. Depending on your address, additional setup work may be needed to activate or connect your broadband line.
I’m still on another broadband contract. Can I switch to GOMO Broadband?
Yes, as long as there is an available port on your existing Fibre Termination Point (FTP), you can subscribe if your address is eligible.
If not, you may need to terminate your current service before signing up, or request to install an additional FTP (additional charges may apply).
Plans & promotions
What is the difference between GOMO Broadband Value Saver Plan and Core Saver Plan?
Both plans provide 10Gbps broadband at $29.99, billed every 30 days. The main differences are the contract length and what’s included:
10Gbps Value Saver Plan
24-month contract
NLT activation included
D-Link WiFi 7 router included
Professional installation included
10Gbps Core Saver Plan
12-month contract
NLT activation included
Router and professional installation available as add-on
Choose the Value Saver Plan if you want the router and installation taken care of. Choose the Core Saver Plan if you already have a compatible router and prefer a shorter contract.
Does my GOMO Broadband plan include installation and NLT activation?
Yes. The 10Gbps Value Saver Plan includes professional installation and NetLink Trust (NLT) activation at no extra cost.
The 10Gbps Core Saver Plan includes NLT activation, with professional installation available as an add-on.
Can I get more than one broadband plan?
Yes, you can sign up for multiple broadband plans as long as you have enough ports or termination points. Each new line needs its own set-up, so extra installation charges may apply.
Can GOMO mobile customers get a discount on GOMO Broadband?
Yes. Customers with an active GOMO mobile plan can enjoy GOMO Broadband at $28.80, billed every 30 days. Limited time offer.
Your GOMO mobile plan must already be active before you sign up for broadband.
Eligibility:
You have at least one active GOMO Mobile plan
Your mobile and broadband plans must be under the same NRIC/account
How it works:
Make sure your GOMO Mobile plan is active
Sign up for any GOMO 10Gbps Broadband plan
Your discount is automatically applied when eligibility is met
Devices
What router comes with GOMO Broadband? Do I need to buy one?
If you choose the 10Gbps Value Saver Plan, a free WiFi 7 router is included.
If you choose the Core Saver Plan, you can use your own compatible router, or purchase one separately. GOMO customers can purchase a router on the GOMO app.
Can I use my own or another provider’s router with GOMO Broadband?
Yes, you can use your own router with our Core Saver Plan. Ensure that your router supports 10Gbps speed for the best network performance.
What technical support does GOMO Broadband provide?
Chat with us 24/7 on web or app for help with your broadband service, billing, appointments or connection.
If further investigation is needed, we may arrange an on-site assessment. On-site visits are chargeable if there is no fault found with our GOMO network or the ONT.
For router issues, reach out to the router manufacturer.
Add-ons
What is the Home Internet Filter?
The Home Internet Filter (HIF) is an optional add-on that helps you manage and block selected websites on your home network.
It’s free for the first 6 months, then $3.05 per month thereafter. You can manage HIF anytime on the GOMO app.
Already on GOMO Broadband? For billing, installation or troubleshooting help,
visit GOMO support
